summary: Pt nanoparticles were homogeneously dispersed onto mesoporous silica gel using atomic layer deposition in a fluidized bed reactor (ALD-FBR). The process involved alternating exposure of Pt precursor (MeCpPtMe3) and O2, with a temperature of 325 ◦C. The study aimed to investigate the dispersion and thermal stability of Pt nanoparticles on mesoporous silica gel for catalytic applications.
evidence: Nanoparticulate platinum has been well dispersed onto large quantities of micron-sized mesoporous silica gel using atomic layer deposition in a fluidized bed reactor (i.e. ALD-FBR). The silica gel substrate temperature was kept at 325 ◦C throughout the experiment.
